name: Close current game
description: Open Control Center, navigate to the running game card and pick Close Game.

wait 400
down
wait 400
right
wait 400
cross
wait 400
cross
wait 400
down
wait 400
down
wait 400
cross
wait 2500
ps
wait 400
down
wait 400
left
wait 400
cross
notes: PS5 only. This legacy Control Center macro depends on the remembered icon and running-game card. Verify it in step mode for the console layout before running; use a saved calibrated copy if the layout differs.

name: Open User's Guide
description: Return Home, find Settings from the right edge, open User's Guide and confirm the certificate prompt for a configured local guide page.
notes: PS5 only. Live-tested on the configured console: long PS returns Home; the top strip stops at the profile icon, then left selects Settings. Twenty Up taps reach the first Settings entry regardless of its last focus. The final Cross accepts this console's local User Guide certificate prompt; remove that line if your guide page has no prompt. The script leaves the guide open. It does not assume a particular jailbreak page or close its webview. Language/firmware and guide-host differences can require adjustment.

wait 500
left
wait 500
cross
wait 1500
up 20x
wait 600
cross
wait 1000
right
wait 400
cross
wait 5000
cross
wait 5000

name: Restart PS5
description: Open the PS5 Control Center Power menu and select Restart. Check the Power icon focus in step mode before first use.
notes: PS5 only. Control Center remembers its last icon and icon layout varies. This legacy macro needs its right-tap count calibrated to the console before running; it is not a universal restart command. Restart disconnects Remote Play. Do not append further input commands to this script.
script:
ps
wait 800
down
wait 400
right 10x
wait 400
cross
wait 400
down 2x
wait 400
cross

name: PS5: Return Home
description: Hold PS to return to Home from an application, Settings or User Guide.

name: PS4: Return Home
description: Tap PS to leave the running application for the PS4 home screen.

name: PS5: Start guide loader
description: Press the selected action on the already-open configured User Guide loader page.
notes: Run only after Open User's Guide has reached your loader page. This console's Relapse page opens with the pointer on Jailbreak. Adjust the button/navigation if another host or page is used. The Autoload port check, rather than a fixed sleep, determines completion.
